A '''heavy weapons repulsorlift squad''' was a basic formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Organization==
Similar to a standard [[repulsorlift squad]], the vehicles employed by the squad were outfitted with additional armaments that could, if needed, be dismounted by the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and used as additional fire support. Typical armaments including a [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]], a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[4.4 grenade launcher]] or a light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].<ref name="ISB" />
